Name: Isa's Pastel Weapon Retextures
Author: Isalamiii
Description:
[size=1][color=pink][b]Hello everyone~ ^ - ^

This is my very first mod I've uploaded to nexus! I originally made this for myself, but with the encouragement of my best friend, I decided to upload it here for others to maybe enjoy as much as I do.
[center]Have fun![/center][/b][/color][/size]

[color=#b4a7d6][center][size=1][size=4][b]WHAT THIS MOD DOES[/b][/size][/size][/center][/color]

[center][size=1] [color=pink][b]* Retextures most weapons into my pink/purple/blue designs![/b][/color][/size][/center]

[color=#d9d2e9][center][size=1][size=4][b]HOW TO INSTALL[/b][/size][/size][/center][/color]

[center][size=1] [color=pink][b]* Install both SMAPI and Content Patcher[/b][/color][/size][/center]
[center][size=1] [color=pink][b]* Extract/Open the file with either Winrar or 7zip.[/b][/color][/size][/center]
[center][size=1] [color=pink][b]* Copy the folder and paste it into your Mods folder, NOT the Content Patcher folder.[/b][/color][/size][/center]
[center][size=1] [color=pink][b]* And you're done! Now you can slay monsters in style![/b][/color][/size][/center]

[color=#fff2cc][center][size=3][b]USE[/b][/size][/center][/color]
[center][size=1] [color=pink][b]* You are definitely allowed to use this mod in screenshots, videos, gameplay, etc![/b][/color][/size][/center]
[center][size=1] [color=pink][b]* You are definitely allowed to combine this mod with whatever you want and edit it however you wish for your own use![/b][/color][/size][/center]
[center][size=1] [color=pink][b]* However, please ask my permission before reuploading its download here, or somewhere else! Thank you![/b][/color][/size][/center]

Downloads.Description: Retextures your weapons into my pastel designs. Added compatability for 1.5 update. Needs content patcher.
